name: Kuusou Seihan Keikaku “Ryouko” ~Joshikousei Gekouchuu Stalker Rape Jiken~
original_name: 空想性犯計画「リョウコ」 ～女子高生下校中ストーカーレイプ事件～
source:
No job. No wealth. Still a virgin. The world stacks up against a man.
Eventually his eyes grow narrow. He stares at a cute girl and thinks, "Her."

Follows her to the station.
Surreptitiously takes home her student ledger.
Acquires her phone details, and marks the moment he will strike.
Late at night, after cram school...
He will take her aside, ruin her, fill her with semen, photograph it...
... and use that to blackmail her more.

She will be his slave.
It's such a cinderella story.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158298.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
没有工作，没有财富，甚至仍是处男。仿佛全世界都在与他作对。

最终，他眯起双眼，盯上了一个可爱的女孩，心想：“就是她。”

他跟踪女孩到车站，偷偷把她的学生手册带回家，查到她的电话资料，并选定发动袭击的时机。

深夜，补习班结束后……他会把女孩拖到一旁，摧毁她的生活，让她被精液灌满并拍下照片……然后用这些照片继续敲诈她。

她将成为他的奴隶。

这真是一则灰姑娘般的故事。
